title: EDM depth: 16 / 32-bar maps, serial FM and shaping, multiband by layering or bus, resampling, formant chops, stutter and tape stop
doc: Deeper EDM families on top of edm-core and dubstep (pack glyphcore/edm, #156; docs/CONVENTIONS.md section 14). New ingredient ids only (racks-edm-depth, atoms-edm-depth, ns ed.); accepted edm-core / dubstep items are untouched. C minor, 140 bpm.

section.title: EDM depth: maps, FM chains, multiband, resampling, chops, transitions
section.explain: glyphcore/edm depth layer (docs/CONVENTIONS.md 14). Arrangement grammars as gates: ed.m16* (intro 4, build 4, drop 8) and ed.m32* (intro 8, build 8, drop 16 split A / B, the stutter bar, the last beat), ed.phraseEnds, masks. Sound design: serialFM (FM 0.5 -> one shape stage), fmFormant (native talking bass), multiband by layering (moves mbLow, mbMid, mbHigh with one compressor per band) or on a bus with .split; resampling = capture() of a lane window, replayed through a second chain (docs/LANES.md 6); formantChop with vowel and pitch-step atoms; transitions stutterGate, tapeStop, tapeStopMove. Mastering per genre: docs/MASTERING.md and the suno-track-lab master presets.

racksDoc: Chain-only hook defs of the glyphcore/edm depth layer: serialFM, fmFormant, formantChop, tapeStop (racks) and the moves stutterGate, mbLow, mbMid, mbHigh, tapeStopMove.

atomsIngredient.title: EDM depth atoms
atomsIngredient.doc: glyphcore/edm depth atoms (ed.): 16-bar and 32-bar arrangement maps as gates and masks, phrase ends, a fill mask, vocal chop notes, vowels and pitch steps, a growl line. Import with atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-edm-depth").

serialFM.doc: serial FM growl: saw carrier, FM at ratio 0.5 (a sub-octave modulator) with a 6-to-1.5 index envelope, then one shape stage (the only worklet), high-pass 100 Hz; the FM -> waveshaper chain of a heavy bass in one voice within the CLI budget

fmFormant.doc: FM formant bass (native): square, FM 2 with a slow index decay, vowel sequence per note (a e o): talking bass without a worklet

formantChop.doc: formant vocal chop: saw through a vowel, 150 ms, short attack; pitch and vowel come from the pattern (atoms ed.chopNotes, ed.chopVowels)

tapeStop.doc: tape stop: a saw chord falling an octave over 600 ms while its low-pass closes; the native stand-in for a tape-stop on the mix

stutterGate.doc: stutter: re-trigger the voice as 16ths for the bar it is bound on (a struct gate), the classic pre-drop stutter

mbLow.doc: multiband by layering, low band: low-pass 180 Hz (24 dB) and a slow 4:1 compressor; layer it with mbMid and mbHigh on copies of one voice (or use .split for one bus per band)

mbMid.doc: multiband by layering, mid band: 180 Hz-2.5 kHz, a fast 6:1 compressor (the OTT-style squash of the body)

mbHigh.doc: multiband by layering, high band: above 2.5 kHz, an 8:1 compressor with a quick release (lifts the fizz)

tapeStopMove.doc: tape-stop move: an octave pitch fall over 500 ms on any voice it is bound on (pitch envelope), for the last beat before a drop

m32Intro.doc: 32-bar map: intro bars 1-8 (intro 8, build 8, drop 16 = 32 bars; the drop splits 8 + 8 for a variation)

m32DropA.doc: 32-bar map: first half of the drop

m32DropB.doc: 32-bar map: second half of the drop (variation: answer bass, extra hits)

m32Stutter.doc: 32-bar map: the last bar of the build (stutter / tape stop / gap)

m32LastBeat.doc: 32-bar map: the last beat before the drop

phraseEnds.doc: the last bar of every 4-bar phrase (fills every 4, bigger every 8)

m16Mask.doc: mask form of the 16-bar drop (plain Strudel)

fill4.doc: 1 in the 4th bar of every 4: a fill mask

chopNotes.body: c5 ~ eb5 c5 ~ g4 ~ bb4 c5 ~ ~ eb5 ~ f5 eb5 ~

chopVowels.body: a ~ e a ~ o ~ i a ~ ~ e ~ o a ~
chopVowels.doc: vowel per chop (the formant moves with the rhythm)

chopStep.doc: pitch step of the whole chop phrase per bar (semitones)

growl.doc: bass line for the FM depth demos

recipes.title: Serial FM into a waveshaper
recipes.intent: FM at ratio 0.5 with a falling index, then one shape stage.

recipes.title: Multiband by layering (OTT-style)
recipes.intent: One growl played three times through low, mid and high band moves.

recipes.title: Formant vocal chops
recipes.intent: Pitched chops whose vowel moves with the rhythm, the whole phrase.

recipes.title: Stutter and tape stop before the drop
recipes.intent: A bar of 16th stutter on the bass, then a tape-stop fall on the last.

syntax.title: 32-bar map: drop A / B, stutter bar, last beat
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-edm-depth")
hooks.bind("bass", "fmFormant")
hooks.bind("bass", "stutterGate", atoms.ed.m32Stutter)
hooks.bind("bass", "tapeStopMove", atoms.ed.m32LastBeat)
bass: note(atoms.ed.growl).use("bass", { quant: 0 }).tags("low")
chop: note(atoms.ed.chopNotes).hook("formantChop").vowel(atoms.ed.chopVowels).mask("<0!24 1!8>")   // drop B adds the chops
tagged("low").mute(atoms.ed.m32Intro)
